_comment: Optional per-build labelling rules. Save as rules/<out folder name>.json and
run.py picks it up automatically, or pass --rules explicitly.
Rules are additive and never invent a classification. Everything here adjusts
labels the evidence already produced: bundle provenance, prefab class ids, the
reference graph, and the design enums in decompiled scripts. If a build ships
no rules file at all, nothing is lost - this only exists for the cases where a
build's own naming is ambiguous or its scripts do not spell something out.
Delete the keys you do not need; every one of them is optional.
_feature_aliases: raw folder name -> the label you want to see
_feature_groups: label -> the features it collects, for coarser filtering
_ignore_features: folder names that carry no meaning in this build
_extra_obstacles: Board pieces to badge as obstacles when the build gives no evidence of its own -
no Tiled level corpus, and no item/goal enum in its scripts. Names are matched
_extra_boosters: Same, for power-ups. Needed when a build has no BoosterType enum: without it
its bombs and rockets are read as blockers, because that is what the item enum
